fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2026-07-26, around 02:30, a red scooter bearing registration number TN-01-XX-1051 of the complainant was reported missing from Sevvanthi Colony Bus Stand Area, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-07-29. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Sanjay Anand, using the number 9000000477. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00344, as the mobile number 9000000477 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
fields.Keywords: scooter theft, vehicle, suspect, mobile number, bus stand, scooter, night
